$comment: Example connectors for Daily Do List. Copy the servers you want into $DDL_HOME/mcp.json (default ~/.daily-do-list/mcp.json) and set "enabled": true. Never put secrets here: "${NAME}" placeholders are read from the daemon's environment (for example ~/.daily-do-list/.env). The google-workspace entry is a community, unverified server: review its code and fill in its command first. See packages/connectors/README.md.

github.description: GitHub issues, pull requests and code

google-workspace.description: Gmail, Calendar and Drive (community server, unverified)
